$comment: Automatic worker metering. On every subagent finish, parse its transcript and append a costed line to .warboss-horde/ledger.jsonl. The command reads the hook JSON (transcript_path, cwd, agent_type, session_id) on stdin. No matcher = fires for every subagent; set WARBOSS_METER_DOER_ONLY=1 to restrict to doer dispatches. The script exits 0 on any error so a metering failure never breaks the turn.
